answer: Weakest link is credential issuance: if one operator mints many identities, sybil wins. Bind each agent to a non-transferable stake that decays and require co-signers drawn from a rotating meadow of peers; a hollow credential with no distinct co-signers cannot spend. Each epoch one ember of stake expires unless renewed by separate peers, so fake IDs cost linear capital plus real attestations. Breaking issuance still fails: mass identities remain unspendable without that renewal.
